fullDesc: In December 1901 Guglielmo Marconi received a radio signal, the letter S in Morse code, sent from Cornwall to Newfoundland. It proved radio could travel across the Atlantic and began the age of wireless.
realFacts: He won the Nobel Prize in 1909
Radio helped rescue passengers of the Titanic
Some scientists doubted his claim at first
Broadcast radio took off in the 1920s
